tagline: We bring companies and customers together.
hero_kpi_rationale: The Remaining Performance Obligation (RPO) is a key indicator of future growth in recurring revenue, particularly relevant for SaaS companies like Salesforce. Its significant 14% increase reflects strong demand and solid customer commitment, with $72.4 billion in future contracted revenues.

kpis.name: Remaining Performance Obligation
kpis.explanation: Total future revenues under contract but not yet recognized.
kpis.description: Represents future contracted revenues not yet recognized. An increase indicates strong sales momentum.
kpis.signal: Strong growth in future commitments, signaling sustained demand.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenues generated by the company.
kpis.description: Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: Indicates profitability of core operations before interest and taxes.

kpis.name: Cash from Operations
kpis.description: Shows the company's ability to generate cash from its core operations.

kpis.name: Share Repurchases
kpis.explanation: Amount used to repurchase company shares.
kpis.description: Indicates return of capital to shareholders through share buybacks.

kpis.name: Subscription and Support Revenue %
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue from subscriptions and support.
kpis.description: Measures the proportion of revenue generated from subscription models, indicating revenue predictability.

kpis.name: Current Remaining Performance Obligation
kpis.explanation: Portion of performance obligations to be recognized in the next 12 months.
kpis.description: Represents contracted revenues to be recognized in the upcoming fiscal year.
kpis.signal: Strong growth in short-term revenue visibility.

kpis.name: AI Integration
kpis.explanation: Integration of generative and agentic AI into platform offerings.
kpis.description: Salesforce is focusing on AI to transform customer interaction and operational efficiency, with Agentforce as a key component.
kpis.signal: AI is central to the product strategy to enhance customer productivity.

kpis.name: Informatica Acquisition
kpis.explanation: Acquisition of Informatica to strengthen cloud data management and AI.
kpis.description: The acquisition of Informatica in November 2025 aims to accelerate the AI roadmap and enterprise data management.
kpis.signal: Major strategic acquisition for the AI and data ecosystem.

kpis.name: Agentforce Momentum
kpis.explanation: Success and adoption of the new AI layer 'Agentforce'.
kpis.description: Agentforce, launched in Q3 2025, enables enterprises to deploy autonomous AI agents to improve productivity and efficiency.
kpis.signal: Strong traction for the new AI agent offering.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions (treasury).
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + share buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du bénéfice net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and data breaches
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to cyberattacks and security breaches that could result in customer data loss, reputational damage, and service disruptions. The critical nature of its cloud services amplifies the potential impact.

risks.title: Technical failures and service interruptions
risks.score_rationale: Technical failures could lead to service outages, affecting customer satisfaction and revenues in a SaaS model where availability is essential.

risks.title: Dependence on third-party vendors
risks.score_rationale: The company relies on third-party vendors for data centers, cloud platforms, and other critical services, creating risks of service disruption and loss of control.

risks.title: Regulatory changes and compliance
risks.score_rationale: Regulatory changes in data protection, privacy, and AI could impose high compliance costs and restrict certain business practices.

risks.title: Intensifying competition
risks.score_rationale: Intense competition in the CRM and cloud sector, including major players and AI-focused new entrants, could lead to market share losses and pricing pressure.

risks.title: Acquisition and integration risks
risks.score_rationale: Recent acquisitions (Informatica, Regrello) carry integration, valuation, and synergy realization risks that could impact financial results.

risks.title: Loss of key personnel and talent attraction
risks.score_rationale: The loss of key personnel, especially in a context of high demand for AI and technology talent, could slow innovation and strategic execution.

ai_positioning.summary: The company integrates AI into its products and platforms, notably through offerings such as Agentforce Sales, Service, Marketing and Commerce, as well as in analytics and integration modules, indicating internal and productized use of AI.
